### Esau's False Piety
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/esaus-false-piety
Passage: Genesis 28:8-9
Points:
- External religious conformity can easily mask an unrepentant, self-serving heart.
- Esau sought his father's favor by taking another wife rather than showing true grief over rejecting God's covenant.
- Pursuing the benefits of the covenant without genuine submission to the Lord leads to empty, superficial reformation.
- Believers must root out sin at its core rather than attempting to satisfy God through outward pretenses.
